CM's angioplasty remarks spark debate on medical procedures

The Chief Minister of Kerala's comments questioning the necessity of an angioplasty procedure have ignited a debate among medical professionals and the public. The Indian Medical Association (IMA) stated that such remarks could erode patient-doctor trust. Cardiologists have weighed in, explaining that while angioplasty can be life-saving in certain situations, medication may suffice in others, and the presence of a blockage does not automatically necessitate a stent. The discussion also touches upon whether angioplasty is performed for medical reasons or for commercial gain, with experts urging caution.
